2607.07935.title: path_boost: A Python Package for Interpretable Graph-Level Prediction using Path-Based Gradient Boosting
2607.07935.paper_summary: We present path_boost, a Python package for interpretable supervised learning on graph-structured input data. The package implements PathBoost, a gradient boosting algorithm that automatically discovers predictive labeled paths within graphs during the learning process. Unlike graph neural networks, which are generally difficult to interpret, PathBoost produces an additive prediction model over path-based features that explicitly reveals which substructures drive predictions. To avoid an exhaustive enumeration of all possible paths, the algorithm iteratively selects and extends paths during learning based on their predictive power, using boosting to combine weak learners into a strong ensemble. The package supports both regression and binary classification. Key features include compatibility with scikit-learn workflows, support for custom base learners and selectors, automatic starting node selection, parallel training across anchor nodes, and built-in variable importance computation. We demonstrate PathBoost on molecular property prediction of transition metal compounds, where atoms serve as nodes and bonds as edges, and further benchmark PathBoost against an established graph neural network and a graph kernel method across six molecular datasets. The package is available on PyPI and GitHub under an open-source license.
2607.07935.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 path_boost，一個用於圖結構輸入數據的可解釋監督學習的 Python 套件。<lb/>該套件實現了 PathBoost，一種梯度提升算法，能夠在學習過程中自動發現圖中的預測標記路徑。<lb/>與通常難以解釋的圖神經網絡不同，PathBoost 生成了一個基於路徑特徵的加法預測模型，明確揭示了哪些子結構驅動預測。<lb/>為了避免對所有可能路徑的全面列舉，該算法在學習過程中根據其預測能力迭代選擇和擴展路徑，使用提升法將弱學習者組合成強集成。<lb/>該套件支持回歸和二元分類。<lb/>主要特點包括與 scikit-learn 工作流程的兼容性、支持自定義基學習者和選擇器、自動起始節點選擇、跨錨點的並行訓練，以及內置的變量重要性計算。<lb/>我們在過渡金屬化合物的分子性質預測上演示了 PathBoost，其中原子作為節點，鍵作為邊，並進一步將 PathBoost 與一個已建立的圖神經網絡和一種圖核方法在六個分子數據集上進行基準測試。<lb/>該套件在 PyPI 和 GitHub 上以開源許可證提供。
